title: Sidebar panels — two-row items
brief: Two sidebar panels for herdr-app-tui: spaces with their tabs nested inside, and agents below. Every space, tab and agent owns at least two rows — name on the first, detail on the second — so the sidebar reads like herdr today and gives a finger a real target.

artboards.title: Nested panels
artboards.tradeoff: Closest to the herdr sidebar and the explicit two-row rule; a long sheet when many spaces are expanded.

artboards.title: Focused space
artboards.tradeoff: Only the selected space shows tabs, so every target has more air; one extra tap to reach another space's tabs.

artboards.title: Attention first
artboards.tradeoff: Agents move above spaces when one needs you, so nothing important scrolls off; the panel order can break muscle memory.

artboards.title: Item blocks and overflow
artboards.tradeoff: Continuous bands and a two-cell step make each two-row item and its tabs unmistakable without connector lines; overflow clips only between whole blocks, at the cost of one row per clipped edge.
